scope: offline firmware protocol, transport, selection, acquisition, calibration intervals, preparation and archive regression

tests.command: python -B -m pytest -q tests/test_pressure_v2.py tests/test_temperature_protocol.py tests/test_temperature_capture.py tests/test_temperature_firmware.py tests/test_temperature_ramp.py tests/test_temperature_plateau.py tests/test_pressure_calibration.py tests/test_pressure_archive.py

firmware_host_transcript.meaning: native host mock of actual ino source; not a hardware measurement

runtime_selection.verified: S2 to S5 to S2; fresh tokens; stale frames excluded; active calibration interval and zero/clear pending block switching; new interval must equal current confirmed channel
runtime_selection.manifest_channels: actual observed channels; initial_pressure_channel remains the initial request
runtime_selection.window_reset: successful selection resets live trend and stability windows; historical points remain

limitations: Digital ACK confirms firmware-reported TCA state, not physical ink-pad identification or analogue health
No force/temperature calibration accuracy or hardware switching timing has been measured
Original serial bytes preserved, waiting/stale frames excluded from structured samples
